Zero. Zilch. Nada. That's how many HOT setups we’ve got on the board today. You gotta be kidding me, right? Not a single ticker scoring a 90 or above? When was the last time that happened? This isn't just low-hanging fruit… the tree's empty. The market isn’t gifting us squeezes, folks. That tells us everything we need to know right now. **Risk appetite is in a deep freeze. Full stop.**  

Zooming out, the macro outlook continues to scream “neutral,” but with this kind of dryness in momentum setups, you’d think we’re bracing for an event. Earnings season is winding down, and the Fed’s in radio silence ahead of next week’s meeting, but the market? It’s whispering. It’s whispering to us that nobody’s swinging big right now. Big money isn’t chasing breakouts, and without sustainers, there’s a vacuum in momentum. Are we listening? Because the bears, yeah — they’ve got nothing here either. No fresh lows, no breakdowns to short. It’s like everyone’s just staring at each other, waiting to see who flinches first.  

So, no HOT setups, no WARM setups, nothing popping off that says, “Hey, you gotta look at this.” And I’m not out here trying to force trades just for the sake of it. But let’s talk about what *is* working, because there’s still some heat in the portfolio, and boy, we’ve got a few names that are just dripping in opportunity if you have the patience to ride them out. Take $KMB, crushed it already with a 2x, and it’s still out there hunting for more. That’s leadership in staples at its finest. $MRNA and $PGEN? Biotech darlings, both already delivered that sweet double-your-money action. If you’re late to these parties, don’t sweat it. There’s more where that came from — just gotta wait for the next batch of setups. Timing is everything.  

But you really wanna talk late entries? Let’s keep it real. $UUUU and $NNE are the uranium plays still firing on all cylinders. The nuclear trade hasn’t gone anywhere despite all the noise. And shipping? $FRO is cruising along with a fat 90% max return. This isn’t the time to throw darts. Let’s ride what’s working. The rest? Dead money until it isn’t.  

So, what’s today about? Watch the indices. The $SPY couldn’t care less about your feelings — if it wants to chop sideways, it will. Keep an eye on volume. And if we’re lucky, we’ll get a squeeze back on the radar tomorrow. Breakouts live and die by liquidity — no flow, no fireworks. Here’s your cheat code: patience pays.
